books.description: Zoe Hale takes her twin sister's place at the altar and marries cold tycoon Ethan Sinclair, a man who wants nothing and lets nothing own him. A year of separate beds ends the night Ethan starts hearing every reckless thought inside her head. Now he wants to know who she really is.
books.title: My Celibate Husband Hears My Dirty Mind

books.description: A dragon prince falls for his brother's widow. But Eve is her twin, raising her sister's dragon baby. When the real widow crashes their wedding, does he love Eve—or the woman she's pretending to be?
books.title: The Dragon King's Swapped Bride

books.description: Jack, the undefeated King of Odds, comes home to find his parents murdered under a wolf's mark. Hiding who he is, he walks into Alice's failing casino, where loan shark Max is squeezing her for eight million. Card by card Jack takes back the tables, forces Max into a last all-in hand and exposes him. The casino reopens, and Jack stays with Alice.
books.title: All in: The Dealer's Return

books.description: For years, Wayne has disguised himself as Eden's most useless playboy, secretly biding his time to uncover the truth behind his mother Eileen's murder. When the president's marriage trials attract dangerous S-rank fugitives, Wayne seizes the opportunity to prove his strength and gain power. But as Veronica's family and the president's daughter, Evelyn, plot against him, Wayne must fight back while keeping his true identity as the Shadow Ranger hidden.
books.title: The Nightclub Playboy Is Secretly an SSS-Class Hero

books.description: A storm sends Lila to her best friend's estate, where she enters her father's bedroom by mistake, awakening the desires of Dracen, a 5,000-year-old black dragon king. Her sacred blood draws predators and the serpent queen's jealousy. He gives her a dragon-bone whistle, vows to arrive within three seconds of its call, and teaches her to fight. Facing abduction, deadly plots, and Kael's obsession, she fights beside him. Love helps them become their best selves.
books.title: Marrying My Bestie's Dragon Dad

books.description: Art student Ethan chases the deep voice from a blindfolded bar night, discovering it belongs to his best friend's father, his new professor. As he uncovers the truth, campus rival Vincent frames and kidnaps him. The professor saves him, leading to a kiss and a shocking reveal.
books.title: My Professor 'Daddy' is My Best Friend's Father!

books.description: Evelyn Morgan hid her Ashcroft heiress identity from her husband for three years. Then the pink Rolls-Royce her father gave her is taken by another woman, and she learns Daniel handed her name to Chloe, the student he sponsors. Branded an impostor and left bleeding, Evelyn makes one call to her father's assistant.
books.title: Hands Off My Rolls-Royce

books.description: My new roommate is gorgeous, dangerous, and obsessed with me. She spoils me and protects me. But when I discover she's the daughter of a mafia boss, I realize falling for her is the most dangerous thing I've ever done.
books.title: Sleeping with My Mafia Princess

books.description: Wasteland wolf girl Amber, bearing ancient god power, is reclaimed by the royal family. Fake heiress Elena and Prince Allen frame her with poisoned tea, broken blades, and rune seals. Amber turns their traps against them, slays a frost gryphon, and is forced to hunt a dragon. Sealed and swallowed, she bursts from its belly, summons the war god Ares' colossus, and cleaves the beast in one axe stroke—declaring revenge.
books.title: Abandoned Wolf Girl：Now I Reign

books.description: For seven years, Claire was the voice behind superstar Brooke's fame. Her so-called best friend stole her songs, secretly drugged her to make her gain weight, and even stole her boyfriend! Betrayed and humiliated, Claire is ready to fight back. With a powerful music mogul by her side, she plans the ultimate revenge: exposing Brooke's lies on the Grammy stage, LIVE! But when the spotlight finally hits Claire, will anyone recognize the woman she's become?
books.title: Big Girl Steal the Show

books.description: After being framed as pregnant and killed by her fiancé's childhood friend Wendy, attorney Hailey gets a second chance at life. This time, she has her best friend Felix disguise himself for the rigged ultrasound—and the machine declares a man pregnant. As Hailey exposes the lie and breaks free from Vincent, billionaire heir Tristan returns to stand by her. But Wendy and Vincent aren't finished. Can Hailey protect her mother and claim the love she deserves?
books.title: Pregnant at My Pre-Marital Checkup? But the Ultrasound Was on a Man!

books.description: On their fifth anniversary, Brian Lodge abandons his wife, Linda Grant, and their son, Tim, for his childhood sweetheart. That night, Linda and Tim get into a tragic car crash in the rain—one that costs Tim his eye. Unable to let Tim lose his father too, Linda gives a begging Brian a second chance… until she uncovers the horrifying truth behind how her son really lost his eye.
books.title: I Loved You Until It Hurt

books.description: Claire Morgan, heiress to Wall Street's richest family, has been blind for three years. At her fiance Marcus's banquet she is mistaken for a beggar impostor and publicly humiliated; he refuses her and his men put a gun to her head. Then she presses her rescue bracelet, and her father's helicopters arrive. Blind, she still rules them all.
books.title: The Blind Heiress Rules Them All

books.description: Elena, a world-class champion nanny, dies in a freak accident and awakens as a lowly human maid in a dragon kingdom—gifted with the power to understand baby dragons. Using her professional childcare skills, she saves the royal twins again and again—loosening the deadly swaddle suffocating Princess Fia, stopping the brutal mechanical cradle, exposing the steel brushes tearing the cubs' wings, and snatching Prince Asher back from death when a sacred fire pearl chokes him.
books.title: Baby Dragons Helped Me Win Dragon King Daddy

books.description: Distanced by her Alpha mate due to his uncontrollable powers, a despairing Luna accidentally summons his 20-year-old, passionately devoted self. Torn between adult Kael's late regrets and young Kael's fierce protection, she chooses self-love, leaving the toxic past to start an independent life with her younger love.
books.title: Craving His 20-Year-Old Self

books.description: One misstep down the stairs sends modern preschool teacher Emily into a magical unicorn kingdom—and straight into the job of royal nanny to seven untamable baby unicorns. They can’t transform, won’t trust anyone, and their wild magic can explode at any moment. With treats, songs, and kindness, Emily wins the little Flame Unicorn’s trust, exposes the cruel steward, and earns King Alexander’s respect.
books.title: Whispering to Unicorns, Won the Cold King’s Heart

books.description: The 'innocent bunny' assistant who gets coffee thrown at her and folders slammed by her tyrannical boss is actually a Queen Dom who brings all of New York to its knees in the underground BDSM scene. Wielding a leather whip, she tames the high-and-mighty Wall Street CEO into her very own pet, helping her take back everything stolen by her husband and corporate investors.
books.title: The CEO's Secret Master

books.description: For 3 years, Mia believed aliens were coming. She stayed locked in a basement, wearing a cardboard helmet, eating scraps. Then a call showed her sister's mansion and birthday cake. Her parents weren't at war—they'd abandoned her. That night, 7-year-old Mia escaped and ran into Dante Russo, the city's most feared mafia boss. Now the underworld's untouchable little princess wants answers. And Dante is hunting every name that put her in that basement.
books.title: The Aliens Said My Parents Never Loved Me

books.description: Debt slave Kai enters a mech arena with scrapped robot UNIT-09. It absorbs scrap to become a battle mech and wins, revealing itself as the last first-gen mech. Ace pilot Sera hunts them; Kai learns his father's last words and a dark truth. When the electromagnetic net closes in, UNIT-09 sacrifices itself to save Kai.
books.title: UNIT-09: The Last Scrap Titan

books.description: Five-year-old Elowyn awakens past-life memories as a genius mathematician. Her son is now a tech tycoon. She joins the Calder clan, exposes a scheming fiancée, protects her great-granddaughter, reclaims her stolen research, and reunites the family.
books.title: I’m Five, But I’m Your Great-Grandmother!

books.description: When fisher-boy Kael pulls mysterious little Lulu from the waves, no one knows her origin. This three-year-old girl can hear warnings from the raging sea. Villagers mock her at first, dismissing her as a silly foundling. But her strange gift soon proves real. She saves her family and the whole village from deadly ocean disasters, bringing hope to everyone.
books.title: Lulu: The Sea’s Small Messenger

books.description: Rabbit Omega Eli disguises as an Alpha at Sacred Beast Academy. He discovers he is the fated Omega of four top Alphas. Forced to live with them, he navigates jealousy, traps, and his own feelings—eventually choosing the domineering Caleb.
books.title: I Posed as an Alpha and Became the Prey of Four Alphas

books.description: God of Arcane Lex dies and possesses frail boy Vahn. Hated by his father, Vahn rises at eight, shattering statues and defeating archmages. To save his mother, he burns his soul to manifest Lex's power and slay abyss monsters—then vanishes, leaving hope for his return.
books.title: Rebirth of the Arcane God

books.description: In a world overrun by bugs, the upper city monopolizes energy and mecha tech while lower-city outcasts barely survive. Kyle, a lower-city reject, kills a royal-class bug alone and becomes the mystery powerhouse the Alliance hunts. Seeking his origins, he enters the upper city—mocked and branded a fake heir. When rivals try to kill Mona at the mecha tournament, Kyle stops hiding. Everyone learns the "trash" is the true Cross heir—and history's strongest mecha pilot.
books.title: The Lower-City Outcast Was the Mech God All Along

books.description: Football legend Kael's soul enters ten-year-old Nico's body after a crash. Using Kael's skills, Nico exposes his uncle's conspiracy, saves the club, and leads a ragtag team to a 4-3 comeback in a winner-takes-all match.
books.title: Pitch Underdog ：The Boy Remakes the Legend

books.description: Elena takes her boyfriend Julian home to her family's rundown farm, and his Thanksgiving proposal dies at the sight of the pigs. He calls in Damian Fox to humiliate them, right up until the Harts arrive. The farm girl they mocked is heiress to Hart Capital, and every insult comes back in court.
books.title: The Farm Girl He Dumped Was the Billionaire Heiress

books.description: She is the most feared pirate captain in the galaxy, living happily with her adopted family. One day, her biological father suddenly appears and demands she return home. To save her dying pirate crew, she hides her identity and enters three deadly trials to win energy crystals. But the real trap goes far beyond the trials...
books.title: The Heiress Returns as a Space Pirate

books.description: Framed for her little sister's death, Joy spends ten years as the family scapegoat. When her twin and their parents implant a black-market chip to kill her Ivy League future, she is driven off a roof. A secretive hacker saves her, cracks the chip, and exposes every lie. Joy erases her memory and walks away, leaving them in regret.
books.title: They Chipped Me to Obey, So I Deleted Them

books.description: Princess Elara marries cursed Beast King Roderick in her sister's stead. Trapped in a dark castle, she expects a monster, only to meet a lonely soul. The full moon awakens his feral side, forcing Elara to choose between fear and mercy. Her father plots to slay Roderick and seize neighboring lands, revealing the curse is built on betrayal. Elara fights to save the man who was never a monster, and take back her rightful throne.
books.title: A Kiss to Tame the Beast

books.description: Ethan thought he had a perfect marriage. But on his fifth anniversary, he listened through a hotel wall as his wife slept with her boss. When he corners them in the conference room, his cheating wife humiliates him and slaps him for being a "jealous loser." Everyone thinks he's just a nobody. Until the hotel manager rushes in and nervously calls him "Mr. Cole."
books.title: Shut Up! My Bunny Girl Wife!

books.description: To enjoy his last bit of freedom before marriage, Nick Frye pretends to have lost only his memories of Ruby Wright in a car accident. Desperate to help him, Ruby spends all her savings on a rumored cure—only to uncover the truth just as she is about to give it to him. Shattered by the betrayal, she changes her name and moves abroad to escape the unbearable heartbreak.
books.title: Bye, Mr. Amnesia

books.description: After awakening an ancient power hidden within a mysterious ring, a seemingly ordinary security guard must protect a powerful CEO from deadly enemies while uncovering the truth behind his father's disappearance.
books.title: Hidden War God: The CEO's Bodyguard

books.description: After her cheating husband throws her out, Claire takes a cleaning job at an elite school to support her adopted daughter—who looks exactly like a billionaire’s little girl! The two secretly swap places, determined to find Mommy a husband and Daddy a wife, only to uncover a family secret buried for seven years. Now Claire’s ex wants to humiliate her again—but this time, she has a billionaire and two little matchmakers on her side.
books.title: Twins Found Me a Billionaire

books.description: Seven months pregnant after three grueling IVF rounds, I'm ordered to drink five whiskeys at my husband's business party. Adrian calls it a test of loyalty after an old friend protects me. I drink to save our marriage. He calls me guilty anyway. Then pain tears through my belly, and blood runs down my leg. I drop my wedding ring into the glass. He thinks I'm a wife he can control. He has no idea I'm an heiress.
books.title: The Billionaire Cruelly Tested My Love, Not Knowing I'm an Heiress

books.description: After dreaming that her husband and stepson will sacrifice her to resurrect his dead ex-wife—trapped inside an orchid mantis—Marina wakes to find the nightmare coming true. But this time, she refuses to be their victim. Armed with knowledge of their deadly plan, she turns the tables, sealing her rival in an insect body and exposing the family that betrayed her. Revenge has never looked so beautiful.
books.title: My Husband Gave Me the Orchid Mantis He Loved

books.description: Best friends Cecilia and Elara are trapped inside a mafia romance novel as the villainous wife and the beloved white moonlight—forced by a visible-only-to-them transcript to play their roles, they exploit a loophole to fake hatred in public while secretly profiting. When the final chapter demands Cecilia kill Elara, they abandon the rewards, ally with Raphael and Damon, and fight Lucian and the story's rules—becoming masters of their own fate.
books.title: We Broke the Mafia Novel
